literal: Giving, fame-arising living; other than that, profit there is not to life.
translation: Giving to others and living a life of fame: other than this, there is no true profit for a living soul.
modern: பிறருக்குக் கொடுத்துப் புகழ் உண்டாகும்படி வாழ்வதைத் தவிர, மனித உயிருக்கு வேறு எந்தப் பயனும் இல்லை.
explanation: This couplet defines the ultimate purpose of human life as generosity and the good reputation it brings. The word 'ītal' means giving to those in need, while 'icaipaṭa' means causing fame to arise. The poet asserts that apart from this noble way of living, there is no other 'ūtiyam' or lasting profit for a living being. Fame earned through giving is presented as the only true wealth one can accumulate in life.
